prompt_inputs.goal: Prepare for a marathon with high-intensity long run training session scheduled for afternoon

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans one full day with at least 4 eating occasions
Includes carbohydrate-rich foods strategically timed before and after the long run
All foods comply with dairy-free restriction
Realistic and compact format suitable for quick reference
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-intensity endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing around long training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and strength for weightlifting competition with training sessions at 6am, 12pm, and 5pm

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three training blocks with appropriate pre/post-workout nutrition
Total daily protein meets high requirements for strength athlete (minimum 1.6-2.0g per kg bodyweight)
All meals and snacks are lactose-free
Plan is concise and fits on a single page with clear meal timing
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize energy and performance for soccer match day with two games scheduled (10:00 AM and 4:00 PM)
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Lactose intolerant, prefers plant-based protein sources

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 3+ meals/snacks timed appropriately before, between, and after matches with digestive consideration
Provides adequate carbohydrates for energy availability and recovery between matches
All meals and snacks respect lactose intolerance and plant-based protein restrictions
Plan is compact and concise (suitable for 1 day format)
